mechanism: Propranolol (non-selective beta-blocker) may reduce the efficacy of levodopa by blocking beta-2 mediated vasodilation and potentially interfering with dopaminergic effects, while levodopa can increase catecholamine effects leading to hypertension and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure and Parkinson's symptom control closely; consider alternative antihypertensive or cardioselective beta-blocker if levodopa efficacy diminishes significantly.
